subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-11-05
html:
Shipped the one code-actionable P0 item that had been stuck for two months as an undecided "delete or wire in?" call. Rank/backlinks still flat (26th straight session, 0/22 tracked keywords; backlinks 3/2; no change expected yet — this is a structural fix, not a ranking lever by itself).

PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
HomepageAdded missing @ids (#business, #website, #webpage, #software) + a new founder Person node to the existing Organization/WebSite/SoftwareApplication JSON-LD; replaced a stale single "$0 Free plan" Offer with a real 6-tier AggregateOffer (Free $0 / Solo $19 / Studio $99 / Agency $249 / Scale $499 / Enterprise custom).AI-answer-engine pricing citation (no single keyword)askarlo.app — view page source, search for application/ld+json
All 6 /services/* persona pages (google-ads-specialist, meta-ads-specialist, account-manager, agency-owner, solo-business-owner, seo-specialist)Added a new SoftwareApplication + AggregateOffer JSON-LD block — these pages previously shipped zero product/pricing schema, only FAQPage.FOCUS cluster conversion funnel (connector-matrix personas)askarlo.app/services/google-ads-specialist — view page source

Why this and not more FOCUS-cluster content: the connector matrix (5/5) and comparison hub (5/5) are re-confirmed fully built out against current demand for the 10th straight session — no new keyword-driven page to ship. This was the highest-value item actually left on the audit backlog.

Next: keep re-pulling FOCUS keywords/catalogs each session; the homepage's schema is still hand-synced to pricing data rather than generated at build time (a future pricing change needs updating in two places) — fixing that touches the human-OAuth-gated static-render pipeline, flagged not attempted. Everything else open (GSC sitemap submission, off-page listings, AI Result Tracker LLM engine config, CSP, www redirect, IndexNow, second testimonial) remains a human decision.
